plugin.name: Midnight Club LA Remix PPSSPP Fusion Fix
ForceAspectRatio.description: Auto follows PPSSPP's display aspect. Enable Stretch in PPSSPP's display layout for widescreen. Enter W:H or a decimal (1:1 to 4:1) to override it. Changes apply while playing.
FOVFactor.description: Scales the field of view of the 3D view from 0.5 to 2.0; 1.0 keeps the original angle. The race opening fly-by keeps its own framing. Changes apply while playing.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto places the race HUD at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centered box (4:3 to 32:9). Changes apply while playing.
HUDScale.description: Resizes the race HUD around its screen-edge anchors (0.5 to 1.5). Menus and loading screens keep their original size. Changes apply while playing.
CutsceneBorders.description: Keeps the framing of the race opening fly-by. Letterbox adds bars above and below on screens narrower than 16:9; Pillarbox adds side bars on wider screens. Both keeps the original view at every aspect. Off fills the screen with a wider view. Changes in the Plugins menu apply immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the legal, Rockstar and opening videos and the startup notice that only has an OK button. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
DualAnalogPatch.description: Turns the chase camera with the right stick: sideways looks left and right, pulling back looks behind. The D-pad look buttons keep working. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
TextLanguage.description: Language of the Fusion Fix pages in the pause menu. Auto follows the PSP system language. Changes in the Plugins menu apply immediately.
menu.restart: Restart the emulated game to apply all changes.
menu.preset.help: Vanilla keeps the original intro and D-pad-only camera. Recommended and Enhanced skip the intro and turn on the right-stick camera. Other settings keep your values.
